title: Worry and debt
cue: Refuge from worry, grief, helplessness and debt
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-jubni wal-bukhl, wadala'id-dayni waghalabatir-rijaal
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6369: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9554

when: When worried, or at any time
